title: Word from the North
html:
This quest is not fully written yet. Steps, items or dialogue may be missing.A dwarf envoy has come down to Binxonia looking for help. His crew came north to reopen an old iron mine and found it taken.

About

Given byDwarf Envoy
Level11
LengthShort
KindSide
Quest points1

What you need

Nothing to bring in the steps recorded so far.

Steps

  1. Talk to Dwarf Envoy (outdoors near Binxonia) to get the quest.
  2. Talk to the Greywood Foreman at -556, -370

Rewards

Reward
Gold160
Character XP5,000
Quest points1

What Dwarf Envoy says

You: The envoy in Binxonia sent me.

Greywood Foreman: Then he found somebody at last. Good. We need the hands.

Greywood Foreman: We came here to dig iron. Instead I have a mine full of kobolds and a camp that loses something every night.

Greywood Foreman: Get your bearings and come back to me. There's no shortage of work up here.

Handing it in

"Get your bearings and come back to me. There's no shortage of work up here."
